checks.description: Pilot-specific primary path, partial failure, sort, selection, pagination, row action, and detail disclosure.
Tab order, visible focus, dialog containment, Escape close, and trigger focus restoration.
Visible interactive elements expose non-empty accessibility snapshots.
Desktop, Tablet, Mobile, RTL, long Japanese, and 200 percent zoom do not create document-level horizontal overflow.
Forced-colors media is active and the Pilot remains operable.
Visible interactive controls expose an effective target of at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.
Page errors, unhandled rejections, console errors, resource footprint, and build warnings are recorded.
Manual VoiceOver plus Chrome check; no conformance may be inferred from automated evidence.
